International honours again fell to John Gladwin and Ernie Obeng while Abi Ekoku becomes a new name for the club honours Board with an England Under 23 appearance, as does Felix Sandy who ran in the World Championships for Sierra Leone.

Never mind there were some very high standards set in this last match for a supposed low key league with, for example, Felix Sandy running 21.6 and finishing 2nd and Phil Walker running a fine pb for 800m - 1.53.7 - and only in 4th!

Our next fastest man was Sierra Leone International Felix Sandy who had signed membership after the Commonwealth Games last season. Felix spent most of the year in the USA where we understand he recorded a best of 10.38.
